measures.title: Chatham County School Board Ad Valorem Tax Referendum
measures.summary: Asks whether to approve a state act amending the adjusted base year assessed value homestead exemption from Chatham County and City of Savannah School District taxes for educational purposes. Under the act, the adjusted base year assessed value of a homestead could not increase above the homestead's assessed value in tax year 2025.
measures.yesMeans: The act is approved and the base year value used for the school tax homestead exemption is capped at the homestead's 2025 assessed value.
measures.noMeans: The act is not approved and the school tax homestead exemption is not changed by it.
